description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three models — RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) — across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.50 and 1.00. Each category contains three grouped bars: dark purple for RedWhale, light blue for EEVE-Korean, and light gray for SOLAR (base). In every category, the SOLAR model achieves a perfect score of 1.00, serving as a baseline. RedWhale consistently outperforms EEVE-Korean in all categories except KoBEST-CP, where EEVE scores 0.74 versus RedWhale’s 0.71. Notable scores include RedWhale’s 0.69 on KoBEST-SN and 0.57 on AVG, compared to EEVE’s 0.73 and 0.61 respectively. The chart visually emphasizes RedWhale’s competitive performance relative to EEVE, while SOLAR remains at ceiling performance across all tasks.
